description: How old is your pet in human years? Enter birthdate and species for exact age plus human-equivalent years.

faqs.a: Dogs: 15 years for year one, 9 for year two, 5 per year after. Cats: 15 / 9, then 4 per year after. Partial years are prorated monthly.
Yes — the same 15/9/4 rule used by vets works for all cat breeds.
faqs.q: Does it work for all cat breeds?

faqs.a: It shows exact years, months and days of actual age, plus the human-equivalent age.

howto: Enter your pet's name and birthdate.
See exact age and human-equivalent years.
title: Pet Age Tracker
